wizard.draftAmbiguousBody: You have {{count}} unfinished expense claims saved from other tabs.
wizard.discardBody: Discard this claim and clear the form? Any part you already saved as a draft on the server is not deleted — you can find and delete it from your expense claims list.
wizard.receiptPolicyBody:
You may upload up to 10 images and/or PDF documents as receipts — they'll be merged into a single PDF for our accounting system.

All claims must be in the same currency — do NOT mix currencies (e.g. EUR and SEK) within a single claim.

FX rates are based on the rates supplied by a 3rd-party API (frankfurter.app), using the expense date you provide.

Mileage claims use {{discountPct}}% of the Finnish Tax Administration (Vero) official rate.

For fuel re-imbursement, enter the total litres of uplift and the total paid (including any handling fees).
